authorization: The Owner's explicit J16 instruction authorizes archived-data analysis and bounded solver diagnostics, targeted code and tests, and prospective harmonic work. It excludes publication, release, tagging, and merge.

execution.retry_policy: No automatic retry. Another attempt requires a separately identified source change or diagnostic hypothesis, a new contract/series/attempt ID, and a new ledger entry.

inputs.selected_checkpoint_artifacts: The JSON and NPZ pair for each listed frequency; each SHA-256 and byte count is verified against the immutable J15 input manifest before matrix assembly.
inputs.matrix_origin: New reduced dynamic impedances assembled from the exact J15 QF source and the unchanged NAFEMS 13H model; archived J15 reduced response vectors are comparison inputs, not replacements.

model.boundary_conditions: UX=UY=RZ=0 at every node; UZ=0 on all four edges; RY=0 on bottom/top edges; RX=0 on left/right edges.

methods.threshold_policy: Recompute the existing guard on each candidate solution using the original unscaled matrix and unchanged historical threshold; do not amend historical status.
solvers: SciPy spsolve on the unscaled reduced impedance.
SciPy spsolve after one row and one column infinity-sum equilibration; map the solution back to the original variables.
SciPy SuperLU factorization with two correction steps whose residuals are computed in complex128.
observables: guard upper bound on the original system
relative solution difference from unscaled spsolve
relative difference to the archived J15 reduced vector

interpretation_and_completion.diagnostic_question: Determine whether scaling or same-precision iterative refinement changes the computed residual, guard bound, or response for the same QF-assembled system.
interpretation_and_completion.completion_checks: Verify ten selected archived inputs; preserve the five historical QF_GUARD_REJECTED statuses; write all five matrices, right-hand sides, solutions, metrics, and hashes; do not produce a mechanical PASS.
interpretation_and_completion.scope_limit: This tests solution methods on QF-assembled matrices. It is not an independent check of QF assembly, the plate formulation, or physical accuracy. A low backward error alone is not physical verification.

resources.estimate: Five solves of a 175-DOF reduced system and five condition estimates are expected to remain well below 10 minutes; this is an engineering estimate, not a measurement.

artifacts_to_preserve: Verified input-manifest SHA and the ten selected J15 input artifacts.
Per-frequency original complex impedance, RHS, unscaled/scaled/refined vectors, JSON metrics, and SHA-256 manifest.
Runner preflight, attempt ledger entry, resource observations, environment, source fingerprint, and logs.
All historical J15 artifacts and statuses without edits.
